title: lyonia formosa
intro: Lyonia formosa, commonly known as the fragrant sapphireberry or mountain sweetberry, is a species of flowering plant in the heath family, Ericaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lyonia formosa are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
